notes.zh: 随机遗址：权重+100，出现在熔岩星球（pc_molten）上；没有 has_infernals 时权重为0；全银河最多一处（common/archaeological_site_types/14_infernals_arc_sites.txt:2）。
notes.en: A random site: +100 on molten planets (pc_molten), weight 0 without has_infernals; at most one per galaxy (common/archaeological_site_types/14_infernals_arc_sites.txt:2).

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.
